title: WAF Richieste
description: Ogni richiesta passata dal WAF: esito e, se bloccata, regola e causa.

list.name: site
list.label: Sito
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT site_id FROM waf.agg_requests_1m WHERE minute > now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY ORDER BY site_id

list.name: esito
list.label: Esito
list.query: Bloccate : BLOCK, Consentite : ALLOW, In count (bloccherebbero) : COUNTED, Errore WAF : FAIL

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() FROM waf.events e WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR e.site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND ('__all__' IN (${esito:singlequote}) OR e.action IN (${esito:singlequote}) OR ('COUNTED' IN (${esito:singlequote}) AND e.action = 'ALLOW' AND e.request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND configured_action = 'COUNT'))) AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR e.client_ip = ${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${cerca:sqlstring} = '' OR positionCaseInsensitive(concat(e.host, e.path, '?', e.query, ' ', e.terminating_rule), ${cerca:sqlstring}) > 0)

SELECT countIf(e.action = 'BLOCK') FROM waf.events e WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR e.site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND ('__all__' IN (${esito:singlequote}) OR e.action IN (${esito:singlequote}) OR ('COUNTED' IN (${esito:singlequote}) AND e.action = 'ALLOW' AND e.request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND configured_action = 'COUNT'))) AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR e.client_ip = ${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${cerca:sqlstring} = '' OR positionCaseInsensitive(concat(e.host, e.path, '?', e.query, ' ', e.terminating_rule), ${cerca:sqlstring}) > 0)

SELECT if(count() = 0, 0, countIf(e.action = 'BLOCK') / count()) FROM waf.events e WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR e.site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND ('__all__' IN (${esito:singlequote}) OR e.action IN (${esito:singlequote}) OR ('COUNTED' IN (${esito:singlequote}) AND e.action = 'ALLOW' AND e.request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND configured_action = 'COUNT'))) AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR e.client_ip = ${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${cerca:sqlstring} = '' OR positionCaseInsensitive(concat(e.host, e.path, '?', e.query, ' ', e.terminating_rule), ${cerca:sqlstring}) > 0)

panels.title: In count (bloccherebbero)
panels.description: Richieste consentite su cui una regola in modalità count ha trovato qualcosa: sarebbero bloccate se la regola fosse in block. Su Odoo sono soprattutto RPC con HTML nel body.

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(e.action = 'ALLOW' AND e.request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND configured_action = 'COUNT')) FROM waf.events e WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR e.site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND ('__all__' IN (${esito:singlequote}) OR e.action IN (${esito:singlequote}) OR ('COUNTED' IN (${esito:singlequote}) AND e.action = 'ALLOW' AND e.request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND configured_action = 'COUNT'))) AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR e.client_ip = ${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${cerca:sqlstring} = '' OR positionCaseInsensitive(concat(e.host, e.path, '?', e.query, ' ', e.terminating_rule), ${cerca:sqlstring}) > 0)

SELECT uniq(e.client_ip) FROM waf.events e WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR e.site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND ('__all__' IN (${esito:singlequote}) OR e.action IN (${esito:singlequote}) OR ('COUNTED' IN (${esito:singlequote}) AND e.action = 'ALLOW' AND e.request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND configured_action = 'COUNT'))) AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR e.client_ip = ${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${cerca:sqlstring} = '' OR positionCaseInsensitive(concat(e.host, e.path, '?', e.query, ' ', e.terminating_rule), ${cerca:sqlstring}) > 0)

SELECT uniqIf(e.client_ip, e.action = 'BLOCK') FROM waf.events e WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR e.site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND ('__all__' IN (${esito:singlequote}) OR e.action IN (${esito:singlequote}) OR ('COUNTED' IN (${esito:singlequote}) AND e.action = 'ALLOW' AND e.request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND configured_action = 'COUNT'))) AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR e.client_ip = ${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${cerca:sqlstring} = '' OR positionCaseInsensitive(concat(e.host, e.path, '?', e.query, ' ', e.terminating_rule), ${cerca:sqlstring}) > 0)

SELECT $__timeInterval(e.ts) AS time, countIf(e.action = 'ALLOW') AS consentite, countIf(e.action = 'BLOCK') AS bloccate FROM waf.events e WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR e.site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND ('__all__' IN (${esito:singlequote}) OR e.action IN (${esito:singlequote}) OR ('COUNTED' IN (${esito:singlequote}) AND e.action = 'ALLOW' AND e.request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND configured_action = 'COUNT'))) AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR e.client_ip = ${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${cerca:sqlstring} = '' OR positionCaseInsensitive(concat(e.host, e.path, '?', e.query, ' ', e.terminating_rule), ${cerca:sqlstring}) > 0) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT if(e.terminating_type = 'RATE_BASED', 'Rate limit', waf_causa(t.rule_name, e.terminating_type)) AS causa, count() AS richieste FROM waf.events e LEFT JOIN (SELECT request_id, rule_id, rule_name FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)) t ON t.request_id = e.request_id AND t.rule_id = e.terminating_rule_id WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR e.site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND ('__all__' IN (${esito:singlequote}) OR e.action IN (${esito:singlequote}) OR ('COUNTED' IN (${esito:singlequote}) AND e.action = 'ALLOW' AND e.request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND configured_action = 'COUNT'))) AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR e.client_ip = ${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${cerca:sqlstring} = '' OR positionCaseInsensitive(concat(e.host, e.path, '?', e.query, ' ', e.terminating_rule), ${cerca:sqlstring}) > 0) AND e.action = 'BLOCK' GROUP BY causa ORDER BY richieste DESC

panels.title: Richieste (ultime 1000) — clic su request_id per il dettaglio, su IP per filtrarlo
panels.description: Una riga per richiesta. Per le bloccate: Regola = regola AWS/custom che ha deciso il blocco, Causa = tipo di attacco, dove è stato trovato e il valore sospetto. 'Regole in count' = regole che hanno trovato qualcosa ma sono configurate per non bloccare.

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.ts AS Ora, e.site_id AS Sito, e.client_ip AS IP, e.country AS Paese, e.method AS Metodo, concat(e.host, e.path, if(e.query = '', '', concat('?', e.query))) AS URL, e.status AS Stato, e.action AS Esito, if(e.action = 'ALLOW', '', if(e.terminating_type = 'RATE_BASED', 'RateLimit', replaceRegexpOne(e.terminating_rule, '^[^/]*/', ''))) AS Regola, if(e.action = 'ALLOW', '', if(t.rule_name = 'GeoBlock', concat('Paese bloccato (geo_block): ', e.country), waf_spiega(t.rule_name, e.terminating_type, t.variable, t.value))) AS Causa, arrayStringConcat(c.counted, ', ') AS `Regole in count`, round(e.request_time * 1000) AS ms, e.user_agent AS `User-Agent`, e.request_id AS request_id FROM waf.events e LEFT JOIN (SELECT request_id, rule_id, rule_name, variable, value FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)) t ON t.request_id = e.request_id AND t.rule_id = e.terminating_rule_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT request_id, groupUniqArray(rule_name) AS counted FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND configured_action = 'COUNT' GROUP BY request_id) c ON c.request_id = e.request_id WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR e.site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND ('__all__' IN (${esito:singlequote}) OR e.action IN (${esito:singlequote}) OR ('COUNTED' IN (${esito:singlequote}) AND e.action = 'ALLOW' AND e.request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND configured_action = 'COUNT'))) AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR e.client_ip = ${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${cerca:sqlstring} = '' OR positionCaseInsensitive(concat(e.host, e.path, '?', e.query, ' ', e.terminating_rule), ${cerca:sqlstring}) > 0) ORDER BY e.ts DESC LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Blocchi raggruppati per regola e causa

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(e.terminating_type = 'RATE_BASED', 'RateLimit', replaceRegexpOne(e.terminating_rule, '^[^/]*/', '')) AS Regola, waf_causa(t.rule_name, e.terminating_type) AS Causa, waf_dove(t.variable) AS Dove, count() AS Richieste, uniq(e.client_ip) AS IP, uniq(e.path) AS Percorsi, any(concat(e.path, if(e.query = '', '', concat('?', e.query)))) AS `Esempio URL`, any(substring(t.value, 1, 120)) AS `Esempio valore`, max(e.ts) AS Ultima FROM waf.events e LEFT JOIN (SELECT request_id, rule_id, rule_name, variable, value FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)) t ON t.request_id = e.request_id AND t.rule_id = e.terminating_rule_id WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND ('__all__' IN (${site:singlequote}) OR e.site_id IN (${site:singlequote})) AND ('__all__' IN (${esito:singlequote}) OR e.action IN (${esito:singlequote}) OR ('COUNTED' IN (${esito:singlequote}) AND e.action = 'ALLOW' AND e.request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM waf.matches WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND configured_action = 'COUNT'))) AND (${ip:sqlstring} = '' OR e.client_ip = ${ip:sqlstring}) AND (${cerca:sqlstring} = '' OR positionCaseInsensitive(concat(e.host, e.path, '?', e.query, ' ', e.terminating_rule), ${cerca:sqlstring}) > 0) AND e.action = 'BLOCK' GROUP BY Regola, Causa, Dove ORDER BY Richieste DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Richiesta
panels.description: Inserisci o seleziona un request_id (clic nella tabella sopra).

targets.rawSql: SELECT k AS Campo, v AS Valore FROM ( SELECT [ 'Esito', 'Regola che ha deciso', 'Causa', 'Ora (UTC)', 'Sito', 'URL', 'Metodo', 'Stato HTTP', 'IP client', 'Paese / ASN', 'User-Agent', 'Referer', 'Content-Type', 'Dimensione richiesta', 'Tempo totale / upstream', 'Modalità WAF', 'Esito senza override (AWS default)', 'Label', 'Regole matchate', 'Tipo client (Odoo)', 'Nodo / request_id'] AS ks, [ if(e.action = 'BLOCK', '⛔ BLOCCATA', if(e.action = 'ALLOW', '✅ consentita', e.action)), if(e.action = 'ALLOW', '— (nessuna, azione di default ALLOW)', if(e.terminating_type = 'RATE_BASED', 'RateLimit (rate_limit del sito)', e.terminating_rule)), if(e.action = 'ALLOW', '', if(t.rule_name = 'GeoBlock', concat('Paese bloccato (geo_block): ', e.country), waf_spiega(t.rule_name, e.terminating_type, t.variable, t.value))), toString(e.ts), e.site_id, concat(e.scheme, '://', e.host, e.uri), e.method, toString(e.status), e.client_ip, if(e.country = '' AND e.asn = 0, '— (IP privato o GeoIP non installato)', concat(e.country, ' / AS', toString(e.asn), ' ', e.as_org)), e.user_agent, e.referer, e.content_type, concat(toString(e.request_length), ' byte'), concat(toString(round(e.request_time * 1000)), ' ms / ', toString(round(e.upstream_time * 1000)), ' ms'), e.waf_mode, concat(e.aws_default_action, if(e.aws_default_rule = '', '', concat(' (', e.aws_default_rule, ')'))), arrayStringConcat(e.labels, ', '), toString(e.match_count), e.user_class, concat(e.node_id, ' / ', e.request_id)] AS vs FROM waf.events e LEFT JOIN (SELECT request_id, rule_id, rule_name, variable, value FROM waf.matches WHERE request_id = ${rid:sqlstring}) t ON t.request_id = e.request_id AND t.rule_id = e.terminating_rule_id WHERE e.request_id = ${rid:sqlstring} LIMIT 1 ) ARRAY JOIN ks AS k, vs AS v

panels.title: Regole che hanno trovato qualcosa
panels.description: Tutte le regole che hanno matchato. 'Decisiva' = quella che ha determinato l'esito. Le regole in count registrano senza bloccare.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(m.rule_id = e.terminating_rule_id AND e.action != 'ALLOW', '⛔ decisiva', if(m.post_terminating = 1, 'dopo il blocco', if(m.configured_action = 'COUNT', 'count (solo log)', m.configured_action))) AS Ruolo, m.rule_name AS Regola, m.rule_group AS Gruppo, m.configured_action AS Azione, waf_causa(m.rule_name, '') AS Causa, waf_dove(m.variable) AS Dove, substring(m.value, 1, 300) AS Valore FROM waf.matches m LEFT JOIN (SELECT request_id, terminating_rule_id, action FROM waf.events WHERE request_id = ${rid:sqlstring}) e ON e.request_id = m.request_id WHERE m.request_id = ${rid:sqlstring} ORDER BY m.post_terminating, Ruolo != '⛔ decisiva', m.rule_id

SELECT k AS Header, v AS Valore FROM (SELECT mapKeys(request_headers) AS ks, mapValues(request_headers) AS vs FROM waf.events WHERE request_id = ${rid:sqlstring} LIMIT 1) ARRAY JOIN ks AS k, vs AS v ORDER BY k
SELECT request_body AS Body FROM waf.events WHERE request_id = ${rid:sqlstring} AND request_body != '' LIMIT 1

SELECT e.ts AS Ora, e.method AS Metodo, concat(e.path, if(e.query = '', '', concat('?', e.query))) AS URL, e.status AS Stato, e.action AS Esito, if(e.action = 'ALLOW', '', if(e.terminating_type = 'RATE_BASED', 'RateLimit', replaceRegexpOne(e.terminating_rule, '^[^/]*/', ''))) AS Regola, e.request_id AS request_id FROM waf.events e WHERE $__timeFilter(e.ts) AND e.client_ip = (SELECT any(client_ip) FROM waf.events WHERE request_id = ${rid:sqlstring}) ORDER BY e.ts DESC LIMIT 200
